## Schema & Contracts
#185 backfilled 53 schema_version violations in omnibase_spi with wire-format bypass comments and fixed pre-commit hook failures. #141 removed the env-prefix mandate from SPI protocol contracts, clarifying that topics are realm-agnostic. #243 removed residual `from __future__ import annotations` directives from 15 src/ protocol modules, surfacing masked annotation bugs. #1372 added canonical Cursor hook models and enums as a new peer to the existing claude_code/ directory.

## CI & Security
#336 granted pull-requests: read to the ban-hardcoded-runner-ip caller, fixing 125 failed runs. #362 upgraded omnibase-core to 0.47.39 and removed onex_change_control preflight from contract-validation. #3708 re-pinned the repo-evidence caller to the receipt-gate carrying the verifier floor. #1054 removed 5 silent localhost fallbacks in omnibase_core and wired the env-fallback validator as a CI gate. #1006 wired a path-filtered CI matrix with a docs-only short-circuit using a new file zone classifier. #1745 fixed Contract Compliance to read contracts at the PR's own evidence commit and judge test_passes items in CI Summary. #133 bumped actions/setup-python from 5 to 6. #1196 bumped the OmniNode-ai/onex_change_control dependency.

## Core & Infrastructure
#1868 fixed canonical-file-shape to read blobs through temporary files instead of a stdin pipe, resolving macOS pipe blocking issues. #1829 implemented OMN-20200 trusted goal admission with OCC goal verification contracts. #1612 added semantic severity for StatusGrid, removing hex defaults and resolving colour through the theme. #1365 repinned onex-change-control to an immutable SHA to avoid circular dependencies. #1751 fixed the append-only gate to read companion branch commits individually. #1041 added a model health status contract for delegation routing. #1081 routed run-node through contract dispatch and replaced env fallbacks with fail-fast access.

## Omnimarket Features
#3740 added lab job check schedule compute and check effect nodes for supervisor milestone M4. #3504 isolated the DoD proof database environment and reported failures. #2958 declared ownership for claude_hook_events and claude_agent_spans ahead of vendoring. #3785 covered landing release and retry decisions with new contract requirements. #3834 updated omnimarket to install omnibase_infra 0.38.71. #3648 added a gate refusing new deployment facts in packaged routing configs. #3421 implemented node_create_ticket for lab lanes, gated by the installed ticket guard. #3646 added merge-sweep reader, lane brief, and lane dispatch nodes. #3620 published judged acceptance verdicts through the emit daemon and added replay nodes.

## Testing & Verification
#3368 added tests ensuring metering-summary day rows sum exactly to the all-time row. #3298 pinned that a verdict for a tenant-stamped request carries that tenant to an accepting writer.
